newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm oil little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm oil little changed in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm oil prices were little changed in late trading on Friday, traders said.
They said there was not much interest in the market because of a lack of fresh news which could give it some direction.
"The Malaysia market was also pretty slow. It seemed people were only staying on the sidelines," one trader in Medan said.
He said sellers were also reluctant to sell aggressively because prices had been corrected down sharply recently.
He said crude palm oil was offered at around 1,200 rupiah/kg.
Ready olein was quoted at around 1,390 rupiah/kg in Medan and at 1,450 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and Surabaya.
Olein for October delivery was quoted at 1,425 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
